name: Whip between two scenes
what: Your first video pushes in while a frosted-glass tag rises from the bottom and its words appear one by one; then the video whips away to the right with the tag and light streaks sweeping across, your second video settles in from the left, and a big glowing text rises through it and holds.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f8-f40 the glass tag rises from below the frame (accelerating, then a short settle) and its words appear at f28 and f35; f40-f50 it holds; f50-f77 the first video whips away to the right (accelerating, the tag riding with it, light streaks f62-f88); the second video settles in from the left f56-f103 (decelerating) and pushes in slowly f104-f142; f112-f162 a big glowing text rises and settles; then it holds to the end

tracks.name: glass tag
tracks.what: rises from below the frame and settles in the middle

tracks.name: tag words
tracks.what: the words appear one by one, out of a small blur

tracks.name: whip
tracks.what: the first video and the tag slide away to the right

tracks.name: streaks
tracks.what: soft light streaks sweep across during the whip

tracks.name: second video
tracks.what: slides in from the left and settles, zooming out a little, then pushes in

tracks.name: big text
tracks.what: rises through the second video out of a blur and settles

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: everything still (the videos keep playing, the film grain moves)
